title: Assessing Need for Traffic Speed Regulating Measures in Housing Estates
what_it_is: Assessing Need for Traffic Speed Regulating Measures in Housing Estates

sections.label: Road speed limits and measures
sections.summary: LTA sets lower speed limits for residential roads and uses signs, strips and humps, with School and Silver Zones and ongoing monitoring.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: For roads serving residential estates, LTA would set lower speed limits.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: LTA would then implement traffic speed regulating measures to remind motorists to keep to the speed limits.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: Such measures include warning signs or markings, speed regulating strips and road humps.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: All Primary and Secondary schools have School Zones along their frontage.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: Silver Zones are implemented in residential areas with a large elderly population and a relatively higher accident rate involving the elderly.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: In addition, accident statistics are monitored on an ongoing basis to assess the adequacy of the speed regulating measures.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: LTA also conducts a review whenever there are substantial changes to the built environment around the road.

sections.label: Disturbances along Alexandra Road
sections.summary: The disturbances give residents rude shocks along Alexandra Road, and LTA will be asked to discuss with the Traffic Police.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Because this causes great disturbances to our residents, very often giving them rude shocks and this happens very often along Alexandra Road, an area where I serve.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: I will ask LTA to discuss with the Traffic Police.
